newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus 91-day t-bill rate eases to 5.43 percent.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus 91-day t-bill rate eases to 5.43 percent.

text.p: The central bank on Wednesday sold 35 million pounds ($68.5 million) in 91-day treasury bills with an average yield of 5.43 percent , down from 5.47 percent at the last auction on April 2, the bank said.
Bids for bills totalling 42.3 million pounds were made for the 35 million pounds worth of bills on offer. Yields ranged from 5.50 percent to 5.34 percent, the central bank stated. ($= 0.51 pounds)
